newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah rebounds after fixing rates cut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah rebounds after fixing rates cut.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah rebounded against the dollar in moderate late trading on Thursday after the central bank cut its fixing rates, dealers said.
Spot rupiah strengthened in late trading to 2,398/75/99.30 at 0950 GMT after reaching around the 2,402.00/02.50 levels in midday trading. The rupiah opened at 2,398.00/99.00.
"Sentiment on the rupiah strengthened after indications in the market that the central bank was to lower its fixing rates by one point," one dealer with a large local bank said.
